## Kinematic and Kinetic Similarity: Slope

::: {.column width="58%"}
![](figures/fig4-slope.png){height="820"}

::: {.column width="42%"}
- Uphill ($+5^\circ$), level, and downhill ($-5^\circ$) at 1.2 m/s
- Both controllers reproduce the basic GRF structure
  - AP: braking then propulsion
  - Vertical: double peak
- The largest independent-controller error is the **knee moment in loading
  response**, RMSE ratio **8.56**, about $2\times$ the synergistic controller's worst
  moment error
